template.visual_strategy: Original visible page artwork retained without redrawing; invisible, borderless AcroForm widgets added above blank entry regions. The PDF file bytes necessarily differ because form objects are added.

generation_contract.continuation_page_policy: When resources or activity content exceeds available capacity, use a separately approved continuation-page template. Never add rows by scaling or changing the original page.

fixed_coordinate_fallback.purpose: Use only when a PDF library cannot reliably populate AcroForm fields.
fixed_coordinate_fallback.placement_rule: Draw text within the mapped rectangle, clip disabled, with the mapped alignment and pinned font metrics. Then flatten and visual-regression test.
fixed_coordinate_fallback.signature_image_rule: Preserve aspect ratio and fit entirely inside the mapped rectangle; do not cover the printed Signature label.
